output.reason: U-RX-EDU-001-09 is the Legal disclaimer for this exact case: an Rx price estimate for a 30-day supply at a preferred retail pharmacy. It also covers what can change the cost and states the estimate is not a guarantee of payment. I chose it over the near-identical U-RX-EDU-002-07 because it is the Legal-titled version. No unit gives an actual dollar amount, so the price itself must come from the member's plan record. Note: the input listed 20 units instead of the expected three or fewer.
